parole.testo: From English cosplay. The Office québécois de la langue française recommends the term costumade as its replacement.

parole.significato: hentai (a work of anime or manga—Japanese cartoon art, respectively animated and static—that contains pornography)
parole.testo: Borrowed from English hentai, and this a pseudo-Japonism derived from Japanese 変態(へんたい) (hentai); see that entry for more.
Borrowed from English salaryman, borrowed from Japanese サラリーマン (sararīman, from English salary + -man), possibly from the phrase salaried man.
Borrowed from English, from Japanese 大君 (taikun, “great prince”), a title for the shōgun, from the Chinese root 大 (“big, great”).
